story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price MIDCPNIFTY to move about ±4.5%, roughly 13,739 to 15,039. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 59% of the time.
Options cost more than MIDCPNIFTY's recent actual movement justifies: they price 19.2% a year while it has been moving at 13.7%.

For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 14,500 (+1.0% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 13,500 (-6.0%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
Protection against a fall costs more than a bet on a rise, by 1.1 vol points. That gap is on the high side for MIDCPNIFTY against the past year.
